description: This file defines interfaces for an IPC server and client within the Rialto project, including classes IClient and IServer, with methods for managing client connections, sending messages, and server event loop handling.

classes.name: IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a connected client, providing methods to query client info, send events, and manage connection.

classes.name: IServer
classes.description: Interface representing the IPC server, providing methods to manage socket connections, clients, and process I/O events.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Creates and adds a listening socket for incoming client connections.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Creates a new client object from a socket file descriptor and adds it to the server.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns an external file descriptor for event loop integration.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming connections and data, handling server I/O.
